UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid AI slop: make Career Vision Education Services feel like an established, premier, high-trust Indian higher education consultancy.
Dark colors look good when used independently without generic gradients. Use deep Navy #04194E with crisp Gold #FFCD2A accents.
Create depth through layered cards, subtle borders, and 12-24px backdrop blurs on floating navigation and dialogs.
Do NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease'.
Never center align the entire app container or body text. Left-align dense information, credentials, and course catalogs.
Use pill-shaped gold CTA buttons with active/hover micro-animations.
Never use generic AI assistant emoji icons (🤖🧠💡). Use verified Lucide icons (GraduationCap, Award, Building2, BookOpen, Compass, ShieldCheck, IndianRupee, Phone, CheckCircle2, FileText, Sparkles).
